items: Chick-fil-A ranks third among fried chicken chains on consumer popularity — behind two others, despite leading the category on every financial measure

context.text: The chicken sandwich wars began on August 12, 2019, when Popeyes launched its chicken sandwich and the resulting exchange with Chick-fil-A went viral. More than 20 American fast food brands added chicken sandwiches within the following two years.
Fried chicken concept traffic rose 3% in the year ending September 2025 while traffic to all restaurant concepts fell 1%.
Dave's Hot Chicken, Raising Cane's and Church's Texas Chicken each draw millions of visits per month; Chick-fil-A posted year-over-year visit growth from September 2025 through February 2026.
U.S. per-capita chicken availability is projected at a record 102.8 pounds in 2026, keeping chicken the most consumed animal protein in the country.
